# .env.example — copy to .env and fill in
LANGSMITH_TRACING=true
LANGSMITH_API_KEY=lsv2_pt_...
# service key alternative: lsv2_sk_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx_xxxxxxxxxx

LangSmith offers personal access tokens and service keys. Create either one
under Settings, then API Keys; the key is displayed only once, so store it in
your secret manager before closing the dialog.
Documentation mentions a LangSmith API key (lsv2_pt_ or lsv2_sk_ prefix) without embedding the key value.

## Tracing

Older examples used `LANGCHAIN_API_KEY=ls__...`; newer ones use
`LANGSMITH_API_KEY=<your-api-key>`.
